items.name: Watering Can
items.description: Fills from the tap. The garden still needs someone to carry it.

items.name: Hoe
items.description: Turns weeds into soil. Reusable; it does not wear out.

items.name: Basic Hand Tools
items.description: A hammer, a saw, and a pouch of bits. Enough for a fence board.

items.name: Lettuce Seeds
items.description: A paper packet of lettuce. Quick to come up if the bed is watered.

items.name: Carrot Seeds
items.description: A paper packet of carrot seed. Fine for a kitchen or a neighbor's table.

items.name: Tomato Seeds
items.description: A paper packet of tomato seed. Slow, then suddenly too many.

items.name: Flower Seeds
items.description: Mixed annuals. For a porch, a sanctuary sill, or a thank-you.

items.name: Lettuce
items.description: A picked head. Best eaten soon.

items.name: Carrots
items.description: Pulled this morning. Still has the greens on.

items.name: Tomatoes
items.description: Warm from the vine. Enough for a pan of sauce.

items.name: Flowers
items.description: A small bunch. They last a few days in a jar.

items.name: Wood
items.description: A short pine board. Thomas cuts them to fence length.

items.name: Nails
items.description: A paper bag of nails. Number eights, same as the church step.

items.name: Scrap
items.description: Bent metal and usable offcuts. Not pretty, still useful.
